verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only raw DNS record create/read/replace/delete via API and CLI, plus HTTP forwarding rules. These are building blocks a user could use to point a domain manually. Nothing in the pack shows templates, one-click connect, or a guided flow for major hosts and platforms, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, connecting the domain to where my site lives is one guided step — templates or one-click connect for the major hosts and platforms
